roleContext.jobDescription: The developer platform gives the company's external developers the APIs, SDKs and the developer portal for building on its products. The Group Product Manager leads the platform's three product managers: sets the platform roadmap with the product director, owns the pricing and packaging of the API tiers with the commercial team, runs the quarterly roadmap review with engineering leadership, and coaches the product managers. At least eight years of product management with at least three managing other product managers is required. Reports to the product director; works with the platform engineering teams, the commercial team and developer relations.

requirements.text: At least eight years of product management, including at least three years managing other product managers.
Owns the pricing and packaging of API tiers with the commercial team.
Sets the platform roadmap with the product director and runs the quarterly roadmap review with engineering leadership.
Coaches the product managers under a documented coaching practice.
Documents roadmap boundaries and the decisions each review leaves open.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Group Product Manager, Developer Platform

## Experience

- Group Product Manager for the developer platform of a SaaS company since 2022, managing the platform's three product managers; product manager and senior product manager on the same company's API products from 2016 to 2022; nine years of product management in all, three years of them managing product managers.
- Owner of the pricing and packaging of the platform's API tiers with the commercial team, with the two tier changes of 2023 and 2024 approved on pricing proposals under my name.
- Set the platform roadmap with the product director each half-year and ran the quarterly roadmap review with engineering leadership, with the review decks and decision logs in the product folder.
- Coached the three product managers under the product group's coaching practice, with the coaching notes and the growth plans filed with the product director.
- Wrote the roadmap boundary section of each half-year roadmap and the open decisions list after each quarterly review.

## Work samples

- Work sample: one approved pricing proposal, one quarterly roadmap review deck with its decision log and one growth plan, with the product folder references as a verification trail.
